searchText: Pbs would honestly improve ethereum's ui..we have alot of failed transactions on-chain, that users still pay for but builder would automatically filter out failed or reverted transactions while building them.. Those two are not mutually exclusive. It is still very much possible for reverted/failed txs to be included in a PBS-world. As long as the tx if valid, and if it pays the builder/proposer more than some other tx, it makes sense to include it. Youre right about that.. Doesn't flashbots eliminate reverted transctions, i thought they did They might, but maybe only because they're nice. They don't have to (and it might even be against their own financial interests) Only for certain transactions sent privately. I’m sure their builder will include failed mempool transactions Thanks And with crlist whats the garantee that proposers wont select reverted transactions.. So that makes sense..

excerpts.author: pietjepuk
excerpts.content: Those two are not mutually exclusive. It is still very much possible for reverted/failed txs to be included in a PBS-world. As long as the tx if valid, and if it pays the builder/proposer more than some other tx, it makes sense to include it.
